text.en: Every reference in any written law to the Council of State shall be construed as a reference to the Legislative Council.

For the reference to the State Council in subsection (3) of section 244 of the Criminal Procedure Code, there shall be substituted a reference to the Privy Council.

SCHEDULE (Article 3) Education Enactment, 1952 (No 2 of 195:!) section 29 (2) Consular Conventions Enactment, 1953 (No. 3 of 1953) . . . section 9 (4) Customs Enactment, l Q54 (No. 5 of 1954)... section 8 (3) Road Traffic Enactment, 1954 (No. 12 of 1954) section 85 (5) and (6) Made this 29th day of September, 1959, at Our Istana Darul Hana, Brunei, Darul Salam.

OMAR ALI SAIFUDDIN Sultan
